interpretation: Report all three contrasts, every paired-seed difference, conditional opening-family intervals, teacher agreement and complete prediction arithmetic. The main confirmation asks whether soma-side improves both mean policy KL and mean value MSE over dense with both losses improving in each fresh seed, and whether its policy KL improves over the same frozen shuffled-side control in each fresh seed. Report any failure or tradeoff explicitly; do not change masks, horizon, optimizer or decoder using a favorable intermediate metric. A successful result makes soma-side a provisional attachment candidate for subsequent separately registered execution work, not evidence of physiological function, playing strength or advantage over a matched CNN. Repeating one fixed shuffled partition does not establish robustness to arbitrary partitions.
